section_summary.extract_value: This section reports inter-scale correlations among four positive body image measures, three well-being indices, age, and BMI, analyzed separately for women and men. Table 2 presents correlations with results for women in the top diagonal and for men in the bottom diagonal (women n = 716, men n = 432); body appreciation is negatively correlated with BMI in both women (r = -0.35) and men (r = -0.23).
